tagline.zh: 元素随容器滚动,触达最近滚动祖先的偏移阈值后停留——position: sticky; top: 20px; 不脱离文档流,一行声明实现吸顶表头与粘滞侧栏。
tagline.en: The element scrolls with its container, then sticks once it reaches the offset threshold of the nearest scrolling ancestor — position: sticky; top: 20px; never leaves document flow, and one line buys sticky table headers and sidebars.

origin.zh: 出自 CSS Positioned Layout Module 的 sticky 定位:`position: sticky; top: 20px;` —— 元素随容器滚动,直到触达最近滚动祖先的偏移阈值后停留,不脱离文档流;MDN 标注 Baseline Widely available(自 2015-07 起);MDN Layout Cookbook 收录 Sticky footers(内容不足时页脚贴底)与 Split navigation 配方(调研 05§7)。
origin.en: From the CSS Positioned Layout Module's sticky positioning: position: sticky; top: 20px; — the element scrolls with its container until it hits the offset threshold of the nearest scrolling ancestor and stays, without leaving document flow; MDN marks it Baseline Widely available (since 2015-07); the MDN Layout Cookbook collects the Sticky footers (footer pinned when content runs short) and Split navigation recipes (research 05 §7).

effect.zh: 吸顶偏移阈值(CSS 型,注入 --sticky-top)。默认 20px 取自调研 05§7 记载的示例 position: sticky; top: 20px; —— 元素滚到距滚动容器顶部 20px 处停住;0px 是全局导航的常见取值方向,留出阈值可以叠出层叠卡片效果。
effect.en: The sticking offset threshold (CSS-type, injected as --sticky-top). Default 20px follows the example recorded in research 05 §7 — position: sticky; top: 20px; the element parks 20px from the scroll container's top; 0px heads toward global-nav usage, while reserving a threshold stacks cards on top of each other.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 切换 data-trap,给滚动内容包一层 overflow: hidden 祖先)。sticky 只对『最近滚动祖先』生效——中间任何祖先 overflow 非 visible 都会成为它认错的滚动容器,吸顶随之失效。这是 sticky 最常见的生产事故,不是兼容性 bug。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo toggles data-trap, wrapping the scrolled content in an overflow: hidden ancestor). sticky only answers to the 'nearest scrolling ancestor' — any intermediate ancestor with overflow other than visible becomes a mistaken scroll container and breaks sticking. This is sticky's most common production accident, not a compatibility bug.

note.zh: Baseline Widely available 自 2015-07(MDN position,调研 05§7)——三引擎全线可用;失效风险来自布局结构(祖先 overflow / 父容器高度),而非兼容性。
note.en: Baseline Widely available since 2015-07 (MDN position, research 05 §7) — all three engines ship it; the real risk is structural (ancestor overflow / parent height), not compatibility.

fallback.zh: 无需兼容性回退;不支持的环境(极老浏览器)元素按普通流滚动,内容仍可达。真正要防的是结构性失效:① 祖先链上任何 overflow: hidden/auto/scroll 都会劫持 sticky(见 demo 陷阱档);② sticky 元素的父容器高度不足时,元素随父容器一起滚走——粘滞范围以父容器为界。
fallback.en: No compatibility fallback needed; on ancient engines the element simply scrolls in normal flow and content stays reachable. What actually needs guarding is structural failure: (1) any ancestor with overflow: hidden/auto/scroll hijacks the sticky element (see the demo's trap mode); (2) a too-short parent container carries the element away — the sticky range is bounded by its parent.

use.zh: 长列表/长表单的分组标题吸顶——滚到哪组,哪组的标题停在阈值处
use.en: Group headers on long lists/forms — the current group's header parks at the threshold while you scroll

use.zh: 数据表格的表头吸顶,长表滚动时列名始终可见
use.en: Sticky table headers keeping column names visible in long tables

use.zh: 文档站的左侧目录与全局导航吸顶(MDN Cookbook 的 Split navigation 同族用法,调研 05§7)
use.en: Doc-site sidebars and global navs (kin to MDN Cookbook's Split navigation, research 05 §7)

use.zh: 内容不足时页脚贴底的 Sticky footer 配方(Grid/Flexbox 实现,MDN Cookbook,调研 05§7)
use.en: Sticky footers pinning to the bottom on short pages (Grid/Flexbox recipe, MDN Cookbook, research 05 §7)

avoid.zh: 祖先链上有 overflow: hidden/auto/scroll 的布局——sticky 被劫持失效,先修结构再用(demo 陷阱档即此形态)
avoid.en: Layouts with any overflow: hidden/auto/scroll ancestor — sticky gets hijacked; fix the structure first (the demo's trap mode shows exactly this)

avoid.zh: 粘滞元素低于其父容器末尾——父容器滚完 sticky 就跟走了,粘滞范围以父容器为界
avoid.en: Sticky elements near their parent's end — once the parent scrolls past, the element goes with it; the parent bounds the sticky range

avoid.zh: 大面积吸顶层遮挡内容又不提供收起方式——遮挡是布局决策,不是默认正确
avoid.en: Large sticky layers covering content with no way to dismiss — overlaying is a layout decision, not a default

avoid.zh: 同一视口堆叠多个 sticky 层却算不清 z-index 与阈值——阈值设计先画图再写码
avoid.en: Stacking many sticky layers without a worked-out z-index/threshold plan — design the thresholds on paper before coding

a11y.zh: sticky 只改视觉位置,不脱离文档流——DOM 顺序与读屏顺序不变;吸顶元素不得遮挡获得焦点的控件:键盘 Tab 到被吸顶遮挡的元素时,浏览器会把焦点元素滚入视口,但吸顶层与内容重叠区仍需人工核对;吸顶工具条上的控件保持可达;粘滞状态本身不承载信息,不得只靠『停在顶部』传达分组语义(分组标题文本才是信息载体)。
a11y.en: sticky changes visual position only and never leaves document flow — DOM and screen-reader order are unchanged; a sticky layer must not cover focused controls: browsers scroll focused elements into view on Tab, but overlap zones between the sticky layer and content still need manual checking; controls on sticky toolbars stay reachable; the stuck state itself carries no information — never let 'parks at the top' be the only carrier of group semantics (the header text is the carrier).

goal.zh: 复刻 sticky 吸顶分组列表:滚动容器内四个分组,各组标题 position: sticky; top: Npx 吸顶停留,滚动位置实时显示;并提供祖先 overflow: hidden 的陷阱对照档演示 sticky 失效。
goal.en: Replicate a sticky grouped list: four groups inside a scroll container, each header sticking at position: sticky; top: Npx with live scroll readout; plus an ancestor overflow: hidden trap mode demonstrating sticky failure.

acceptance.zh: position: sticky; top: 使用参数快照值(经 CSS 变量注入)
acceptance.en: position: sticky; top: uses the parameter snapshot value (injected via CSS variable)

acceptance.zh: sticky 元素不脱离文档流:后续内容不被上移遮挡,占位完整
acceptance.en: Sticky elements stay in flow: following content is not shifted up or covered, spacing intact

acceptance.zh: 陷阱档在滚动内容外包一层 overflow: hidden 祖先,吸顶失效可见
acceptance.en: Trap mode wraps the scrolled content in an overflow: hidden ancestor with visible sticky failure

acceptance.zh: 吸顶状态变化通过真实滚动监听驱动,不用定时器伪造
acceptance.en: Stuck-state changes are driven by a real scroll listener, never faked with timers

acceptance.zh: 吸顶元素带背景实底,滚动内容从其下方穿过时文字不穿透重叠
acceptance.en: Sticky elements carry a solid background so scrolled content never shows through the overlap
